blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Electrochemistry) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is oxidation number? State the rules for assigning oxidation numbers, giving an example of each. (4 marks)
(Oxidation number kya hai? Oxidation numbers dene ke usool misalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Oxidation number (oxidation state): woh number jo compound mein har atom ya ion ko diya jata hai aur us ki oxidation ka darja dikhata hai; yeh molecule ya ion mein atom ka zahiri charge hai. Yeh positive, negative ya zero ho sakta hai aur sign hamesha likha jata hai.

Usool:
1. Kisi bhi uncombined element ka oxidation number zero hai: S₈, H₂, Cl₂, Na, Mg, Zn ka har atom 0.
2. Compound ya ion mein zyada electronegative element ko negative oxidation number milta hai: HF mein F −1.
3. Compounds mein muqarrar qeematein: group 1 metals +1, group 2 elements +2, binary compounds mein halogens −1; hydrogen +1 (metal hydrides jaise NaH mein −1); oxygen −2 (peroxides jaise Na₂O₂ mein −1, F₂O mein +2).
4. Mono-atomic ion mein oxidation number charge ke barabar: Cl⁻ −1, Al³⁺ +3.
5. Neutral compound mein oxidation numbers ka majmua zero: HCl, (+1) + (−1) = 0.
6. Ion mein algebraic majmua ion ke charge ke barabar: SO₄²⁻ mein S + 4(−2) = −2, is liye S = +6.

book_ref.quote: The oxidation number of any atom or ion can be deduced by using oxidation number rules.

blocks.prompt:
2 Calculate the oxidation number of the element shown in each: (i) N in HNO₂ (ii) P in H₃PO₄ (iii) S in S₂O₃²⁻ (iv) Cl in ClO₃⁻. (4 marks)
(Har aik mein diye gaye element ka oxidation number nikalein: (i) HNO₂ mein N (ii) H₃PO₄ mein P (iii) S₂O₃²⁻ mein S (iv) ClO₃⁻ mein Cl.)
blocks.explanation: H = +1 aur O = −2 lein; neutral molecule mein majmua zero aur ion mein charge ke barabar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, the oxidation number of sulphur in SO₄²⁻ is +6.

blocks.prompt:
3 What is a disproportionation reaction? Explain with two examples, showing the change in oxidation numbers. (4 marks)
(Disproportionation reaction kya hai? Oxidation numbers ki tabdeeli dikhate hue do misalon se wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Taareef: disproportionation reaction woh chemical reaction hai jis mein aik hi substance oxidizing aur reducing agent dono ka kaam kare aur mukhtalif oxidation states wale do products banen. Is mein aik hi element ki aik saath oxidation aur reduction hoti hai, aur yeh wahan hota hai jahan ions ya molecules kai oxidation states mein reh sakte hon.

Misaal 1, hydrogen peroxide ka tootna:
2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂
H₂O₂ mein O = −1; H₂O mein O = −2 (−1 se −2, reduce); O₂ mein O = 0 (−1 se 0, oxidize).

Misaal 2, chlorine aur sodium hydroxide:
6NaOH(aq) + 3Cl₂(g) → 5NaCl(aq) + NaClO₃(aq) + 3H₂O
Cl₂ mein Cl = 0; NaCl mein Cl = −1 (0 se −1, reduce); NaClO₃ mein Cl = +5 (0 se +5, oxidize).

Har misaal mein aik hi element oxidize bhi hota hai aur reduce bhi.

book_ref.quote: For example, the decomposition of hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) to form water (H₂O) and oxygen (O₂)

blocks.prompt:
4 Define oxidation and reduction in terms of electrons. Explain oxidizing and reducing agents with the help of half-equations. (4 marks)
(Electrons ke lihaz se oxidation aur reduction ki taareef karein. Half-equations ki madad se oxidizing aur reducing agents ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Oxidation: electron ya electrons kho dene ka process, maslan Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + e⁻; Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻.
Reduction: electron ya electrons hasil karne ka process, maslan Cl + e⁻ → Cl⁻; Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu.
Oxidation aur reduction hamesha aik saath hote hain; aisi reactions redox reactions hain (maslan photosynthesis aur respiration).

Oxidizing agent: woh atom, ion ya molecule jo doosre substance ko oxidize kare aur khud aik ya zyada electrons hasil kar ke kam oxidation state mein reduce ho. Agar element X aik electron le kar X⁻ bane to woh doosre atom se electron kheenchta hai, is liye oxidizing agent hai; us ka oxidation number 0 se −1 ho jata hai:
X + e⁻ → X⁻ (maslan Cl + e⁻ → Cl⁻)

Reducing agent: woh atom, ion ya molecule jo doosre substance ko reduce kare aur khud aik ya zyada electrons kho kar zyada oxidation state mein oxidize ho. Agar element M aik electron kho kar M⁺ bane to woh electron deta hai, is liye reducing agent hai; us ka oxidation number 0 se +1 ho jata hai:
M → M⁺ + e⁻ (maslan Na → Na⁺ + e⁻)

book_ref.quote: An oxidizing agent (atom, ion or molecule) is that substance which oxidizes some other substance

blocks.prompt:
5 Balance the equation Cu + HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + NO₂ + H₂O by the oxidation number method, showing each step. (4 marks)
(Equation Cu + HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + NO₂ + H₂O ko oxidation number method se har qadam dikhate hue balance karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Qadam 1 (skeleton): Cu + HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + NO₂ + H₂O

Qadam 2 (badalne wale oxidation numbers): Cu: 0 → Cu(NO₃)₂ mein +2 (2 ka izafa, oxidize, Cu reducing agent hai). N: HNO₃ mein +5 → NO₂ mein +4 (1 ki kami, reduce, HNO₃ oxidizing agent hai). Cu(NO₃)₂ ke NO₃⁻ ki nitrogen +5 hi rehti hai, is liye HNO₃ baayen taraf do dafa likha jata hai: aik tabdeeli ke liye, aik baghair tabdeeli ke liye:
HNO₃ + Cu + HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + NO₂ + H₂O

Qadam 3 (tabdeeliyan barabar karein): Cu ka 2 ka izafa kami ke barabar hona chahiye, is liye 2 HNO₃ reduce ho kar 2 NO₂ bante hain:
Cu + 2HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + 2NO₂ + H₂O

Qadam 4 (inspection): Cu(NO₃)₂ ke liye 2 aur HNO₃ (oxidation number mein tabdeeli nahi) chahiye, kul 4HNO₃. Phir baayen ke 4 H ke liye daayen 2H₂O:
Cu + 4HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + 2NO₂ + 2H₂O

Jaanch: Cu 1 = 1; N 4 = 2 + 2; H 4 = 4; O 12 = 6 + 4 + 2.

book_ref.quote: Indicate the change in oxidation number by arrows joining the atoms on both sides of the equation.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: HNO₃ ka kuch hissa oxidizing agent hai (NO₂ banta hai) aur kuch hissa sirf nitrate deta hai (Cu(NO₃)₂). Is liye pehle sirf badalne wala hissa balance karein, phir baqi HNO₃ inspection se jorein.

blocks.prompt:
6 What is an electrolytic cell? Describe its parts and working, and explain electrolysis as a redox reaction using molten zinc chloride. (4 marks)
(Electrolytic cell kya hai? Is ke hisse aur kaam bayan karein, aur pighle hue zinc chloride ki misaal se electrolysis ko redox reaction ke taur par samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Taareef: electrolytic cell woh aala hai jo electrolysis ke zariye bijli ki energy ko chemical energy mein badalta hai.

Hisse:
• Electrolyte: woh compound jo toot-ta hai; pighla hua ionic compound ya ions ka gaarha aqueous solution (aazad ions current le jate hain).
• Electrodes: carbon (graphite) ya metal, jo electrolyte tak bijli le jate aur wapas late hain; anode positive aur cathode negative.
• Power supply: direct current honi chahiye.

Kaam: current chalne par positive ions (cations) cathode ki taraf ja kar electrons lete hain (reduction); negative ions (anions) anode ki taraf ja kar electrons dete hain (oxidation). Electrodes par yeh tabdeeliyan bijli ki energy ko chemical energy mein badalti hain.

Pighla ZnCl₂:
Cathode: Zn²⁺(l) + 2e⁻ → Zn(s) (reduction)
Anode: 2Cl⁻(l) → Cl₂(g) + 2e⁻ (oxidation)
Anode par khoye electrons cathode par liye electrons ke barabar hain; mukammal: ZnCl₂(l) → Zn(s) + Cl₂(g). Oxidation aur reduction aik saath hone se electrolysis redox reaction hai.

Istemal: sodium chloride ki electrolysis (sodium aur chlorine), metals ki refining aur plating, caustic soda banana.

book_ref.quote: When a direct electric current is applied, one electrode becomes negatively charged (the cathode)

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain how the mass of a substance deposited during electrolysis is related to the quantity of electricity. Define the Faraday and show why 1 mole of silver needs 1 F while 1 mole of copper needs 2 F. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke electrolysis mein jamne wale substance ka mass bijli ki miqdaar se kaise mutalliq hai. Faraday ki taareef karein aur dikhayein ke 1 mole silver ke liye 1 F aur 1 mole copper ke liye 2 F kyun chahiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Mass aur bijli: electrode par bannay (ya hatne) wale substance ka mass constant current ki taqat aur us ke guzarne ke waqt ke mutanasib hai, yaani bijli ki miqdaar ke:
Q = I × t (Q coulombs mein, I amperes mein, t seconds mein)

Faraday: 1 Faraday (F) woh charge hai jo 1 mole electrons ya 1 mole aik charge wale ions le jate hain; F = 96500 C mol⁻¹.
Faradays ki tadaad = hasil ya khoye electrons ke moles.

Silver: silver nitrate solution ki electrolysis mein,
Ag⁺(aq) + e⁻ → Ag(s) (1 mol : 1 mol : 1 mol)
is liye 1 F (96500 C) 1 mole silver jamata hai.

Copper: copper(II) sulfate solution ki electrolysis mein,
Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s) (1 mol : 2 mol : 1 mol)
har mole copper ke liye 2 mole electrons chahiye, is liye 2 F (2 × 96500 = 193000 C) 1 mole copper jamate hain.

Aam taur par ion ka charge batata hai ke us ka 1 mole jamane ke liye kitne Faraday chahiye.

book_ref.quote: The quantity of electricity is often expressed in terms of a unit called the Faraday

blocks.prompt:
8 How long will it take to deposit 2.95 g of nickel at the cathode from a solution of Ni²⁺ ions using a current of 1.50 A? (Ni = 59 g mol⁻¹; F = 96500 C mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(Ni²⁺ ions ke solution se 1.50 A current ke zariye cathode par 2.95 g nickel jamane mein kitna waqt lagega? (Ni = 59 g mol⁻¹; F = 96500 C mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Half-equation likhein, mass ko moles mein badlein, electrons ke moles se charge nikalein, phir t = Q/I.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the mass of lead (Pb) deposited at the cathode during electrolysis

steps: Half-equation: Ni²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Ni(s); har mole Ni ke liye 2 mole electrons

blocks.prompt:
9 A molten aluminium compound containing Al³⁺ ions is electrolyzed with a current of 5.00 A for 1.00 hour. Calculate the mass of aluminium deposited at the cathode. (Al = 27 g mol⁻¹; F = 96500 C mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(Al³⁺ ions wale pighle aluminium compound ki 5.00 A current se 1.00 ghanta electrolysis ki gayi. Cathode par jamne wale aluminium ka mass nikalein. (Al = 27 g mol⁻¹; F = 96500 C mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Q = I × t nikalein, phir 1 mole Al ka charge (3F), aur seedha tanasub lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Step 2 Find the number of coulombs required to deposit 1 mole of product at the electrode.

steps: Half-equation: Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al; 1 mol Al ke liye 3F = 3 × 96500 = 289500 C
289500 C se 27 g Al jamta hai

blocks.prompt:
10 What constant current must pass through copper(II) sulfate solution for 20.0 minutes to deposit 0.635 g of copper at the cathode? (Cu = 63.5 g mol⁻¹; F = 96500 C mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(Copper(II) sulfate solution mein 20.0 minute mein cathode par 0.635 g copper jamane ke liye kitna constant current chahiye? (Cu = 63.5 g mol⁻¹; F = 96500 C mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Copper ke moles (har aik ko 2 electrons) se zaroori charge nikalein, phir I = Q/t (t seconds mein).

book_ref.quote: The value of F can be used to calculate the mass of substance deposited at an electrode

steps: Cu ke moles = 0.635/63.5 = 0.0100 mol; electrons ke moles = 0.0200 mol

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe an electrolysis experiment with copper electrodes in copper(II) sulfate solution to find the charge on 1 mole of electrons. What happens at each electrode and why is the anode's loss in mass used? (4 marks)
(Copper(II) sulfate solution mein copper electrodes ke saath electrolysis ka aisa tajurba bayan karein jis se 1 mole electrons ka charge nikle. Har electrode par kya hota hai aur anode ke mass ki kami kyun li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Aalaat (Figure 10.2): aqueous copper(II) sulfate mein khalis copper anode aur khalis copper cathode, jo ammeter aur variable resistor ke zariye d.c. supply se jude hon.

Tareeqa:
1. Khalis copper anode aur cathode ko alag alag tolein.
2. Constant current (taqreeban 0.2 A, variable resistor se constant) naape hue waqt tak guzarein, maslan 40 minute.
3. Electrodes nikaal kar distilled pani aur phir propanone se dho kar sukhayein aur dobara tolein.

Electrodes par tabdeeli:
Cathode ka mass barhta hai kyunke copper jamta hai: Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s).
Anode ka mass ghat-ta hai kyunke copper ions ban kar solution mein jata hai: Cu(s) → Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻.
Anode ke mass ki kami li jati hai kyunke copper hamesha cathode par achhi tarah nahi chipakta.

Hisaab: Q = I × t se hatne wale copper ka charge milta hai; 63.5 g tak barhane se 1 mole Cu ka charge milta hai. Har mole Cu ke liye 2 mole electrons chahiye, is liye aadha karne se 1 mole electrons ka charge milta hai (kitab ka nateeja 99646 C). Is ko aik electron ke charge (1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) se taqseem karne par Avogadro constant milta hai.

book_ref.quote: The procedure is to weigh the pure copper anode and pure copper cathode separately

blocks.prompt:
12 In an electrolysis of copper(II) sulfate with copper electrodes, a current of 0.300 A was passed for 43.0 min and the anode lost 0.254 g. Calculate the charge on 1 mole of electrons and the Avogadro constant. (Cu = 63.5 g mol⁻¹; charge on an electron = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) (4 marks)
(Copper electrodes ke saath copper(II) sulfate ki electrolysis mein 0.300 A current 43.0 minute guzara gaya aur anode 0.254 g kam hua. 1 mole electrons ka charge aur Avogadro constant nikalein. (Cu = 63.5 g mol⁻¹; electron ka charge = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C))
blocks.explanation: Q nikalein, 63.5 g (1 mol Cu) tak barhayein, aadha karein kyunke Cu²⁺ ko 2 electrons chahiye, phir aik electron ke charge se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: A sample calculation is shown below, using a current of 0.20 A for 34 min.

steps: 0.254 g Cu ke liye 774 C, is liye 63.5 g Cu ke liye 774/0.254 × 63.5 = 193500 C
Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu: 1 mol Cu ke liye 2 mol e⁻, is liye 1 mol e⁻ ka charge = 193500/2 = 96750 C
blocks.final_answer: 1 mol e⁻ ka charge = 9.68 × 10⁴ C; L = 6.05 × 10²³ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aam ghalti: 63.5 g ka charge (193500 C) ko hi 1 mole electrons ka charge maan lena. 1 mole copper ke liye 2 mole electrons lagte hain, is liye 2 se taqseem zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 What is electrode potential? Explain the redox equilibrium set up when a metal is placed in a solution of its ions, and why absolute electrode potentials cannot be measured. (4 marks)
(Electrode potential kya hai? Metal ko us ke ions ke solution mein rakhne par qaim hone wale redox equilibrium ki wazahat karein, aur bataein ke absolute electrode potential kyun nahi naapa ja sakta.)
blocks.explanation:
Electrode potential: jab metal ko us ke ions ke solution mein rakha jaye to metal aur solution ke ions ke darmiyan bijli ka potential (voltage) qaim hota hai. Yeh substance ki oxidation ya reduction ki asani batata hai aur volts mein naapa jata hai.

Redox equilibrium (Cu²⁺(aq) mein copper rod): Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ ⇌ Cu(s). Do mukhalif reactions hote hain:
(a) metal atoms ions ban kar solution mein jate hain aur rod par electrons chhor dete hain: Cu(s) → Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻
(b) ions rod se electrons le kar atoms ban kar jam jate hain: Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s)
Jab electrons lene ki raftar dene ki raftar ke barabar ho to equilibrium qaim hota hai. Copper jaisi kam reactive metal ka equilibrium zyada daayen hota hai (Cu²⁺ asani se reduce); vanadium jaisi reactive metal ka zyada baayen (V²⁺ mushkil se reduce).

Electrical double layer: jab zinc ko Zn²⁺(aq) mein rakha jaye to kuch zinc atoms Zn²⁺ ban kar solution mein chale jate hain aur zinc par zaid electrons reh jate hain. Surface ke qareeb kuch Zn²⁺ ions us ki taraf khinchte hain aur electrical double layer banti hai, jo metal aur solution ke darmiyan potential paida karti hai. Is double layer ki wajah se absolute potential seedha nahi naapa ja sakta; sirf doosre system, standard hydrogen electrode, se farq naapa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: During the redox processes, a redox equilibrium exists between two chemically related species

blocks.prompt:
14 Define standard electrode potential. Explain, with the Cu²⁺/Cu and Zn²⁺/Zn half-cells, why one has a positive and the other a negative E° value, giving the half-equations and the terminal at which oxidation and reduction take place. (4 marks)
(Standard electrode potential ki taareef karein. Cu²⁺/Cu aur Zn²⁺/Zn half-cells ki madad se samjhayein ke aik ka E° positive aur doosre ka negative kyun hai; half-equations aur woh terminal bataein jahan oxidation aur reduction hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Taareef: half-cell ka standard electrode potential woh voltage hai jo standard halaat (ions 1.00 mol dm⁻³, 298 K, gases 101 kPa) mein naapa jaye jab doosra half-cell standard hydrogen electrode ho. Alamat E°.

SHE ke muqable mein Cu²⁺/Cu: voltage +0.34 V; copper positive terminal aur SHE negative terminal.
Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s) E° = +0.34 V; H⁺(aq) + e⁻ → ½H₂(g) E° = 0.00 V
Cu²⁺ ions H⁺ ions se asani se reduce hote hain (zyada positive E°), is liye Cu²⁺ H⁺/H₂ half-cell se electrons leta hai aur H₂ electrons khoti hai; electrons SHE se copper ki taraf jate hain.

SHE ke muqable mein Zn²⁺/Zn: voltage −0.76 V; zinc negative terminal aur hydrogen electrode positive terminal.
Zn²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Zn(s) E° = −0.76 V
Zn²⁺ ions H⁺ ions se mushkil se reduce hote hain (zyada negative E°), is liye Zn H⁺/H₂ half-cell ko electrons deta hai.

Nateeja: reduction positive terminal par hoti hai (maslan Zn cell mein 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂), aur oxidation negative terminal par (maslan Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻). Positive E° ka matlab ion H⁺ se asani se reduce hota hai; negative E° ka matlab mushkil se.

book_ref.quote: Figure 10.5 shows how to measure the E° value for a Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell.

blocks.prompt:
15 Compare an electrolytic cell with a galvanic (voltaic) cell. (4 marks)
(Electrolytic cell aur galvanic (voltaic) cell ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Electrolytic cell bijli se chemical tabdeeli karata hai, jab ke galvanic cell khud ba khud hone wale redox reaction se bijli banata hai. Farq ke nukaat table mein hain.

book_ref.quote: A cell in which the conversion of chemical energy into electrical energy takes place spontaneously

rows: Bijli ki energy ko chemical energy mein badalta hai.
Chemical energy ko bijli ki energy mein badalta hai.
Redox reaction khud nahi hota; d.c. power supply se chalaya jata hai.
Redox reaction khud ba khud (exothermic) hota hai.
Anode positive electrode; cathode negative electrode.
Anode (oxidation) negative pole; cathode (reduction) positive pole.
Dono electrodes aik hi electrolyte (pighla compound ya gaarha solution) mein.
Do half-cells jo taar aur salt bridge se jude hon.
Anode par oxidation, cathode par reduction.
Anode par oxidation, cathode par reduction.
Maslan pighle ZnCl₂, NaCl ki electrolysis; metals ki refining aur plating.
Maslan Daniel cell (Zn-Cu, +1.10 V), dry cell.

blocks.prompt:
16 An electrochemical cell is made from an Ag⁺/Ag half-cell (E° = +0.80 V) and a Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell (E° = −0.76 V). Describe how the half-cells are connected, identify the poles, the direction of electron flow and the electrode reactions, and calculate E°cell. (4 marks)
(Ag⁺/Ag half-cell (E° = +0.80 V) aur Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell (E° = −0.76 V) se electrochemical cell banaya gaya. Half-cells ko jorne ka tareeqa, poles, electrons ke bahao ki simt aur electrode reactions bataein, aur E°cell nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Jorna: har half-cell aik metal rod hai jo 298 K par apne ions ke 1.00 mol dm⁻³ solution mein ho. Dono rods taaron se high-resistance voltmeter se jurti hain, aur solutions salt bridge (saturated potassium nitrate mein bhigoya filter paper) se jurte hain jo ionic tawazun ke liye ions ko chalne deta hai magar electrons nahi le jata.

Poles: Ag⁺/Ag ka E° zyada positive hai, is liye Ag⁺/Ag half-cell positive pole aur Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell negative pole hai.

Electrons ka bahao: Zn²⁺ ions Ag⁺ se mushkil se reduce hote hain, is liye Zn electrons khota hai. Electrons bahar wali taar mein Zn half-cell (negative) se Ag half-cell (positive) ki taraf jate hain; electrolyte mein se nahi guzarte.

Electrode reactions:
Negative pole (anode, oxidation): Zn(s) → Zn²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻
Positive pole (cathode, reduction): Ag⁺(aq) + e⁻ → Ag(s)
Mukammal: Zn(s) + 2Ag⁺(aq) → Zn²⁺(aq) + 2Ag(s)

E°cell = E°(positive) − E°(negative) = +0.80 − (−0.76) = +1.56 V

book_ref.quote: For the electrochemical cell shown in Figure 10.8 (a), the two relevant half-equations are:

blocks.prompt:
17 A cell is made from a Mg²⁺/Mg half-cell (E° = −2.37 V) and a Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell (E° = +0.34 V). Identify the positive and negative poles, write the half-reactions and the overall reaction, and calculate E°cell. (4 marks)
(Mg²⁺/Mg half-cell (E° = −2.37 V) aur Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell (E° = +0.34 V) se cell banaya gaya. Positive aur negative poles bataein, half-reactions aur mukammal reaction likhein, aur E°cell nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Zyada positive E° wala half-cell positive pole (reduction) hai; E°cell = E°(cathode) − E°(anode).

book_ref.quote: We can use E° values to calculate the voltage of an electrochemical cell made up of two half-cells

steps: Cu²⁺/Cu (+0.34 V) zyada positive hai, is liye positive pole (cathode); Mg²⁺/Mg (−2.37 V) negative pole (anode)
Mukammal: Mg(s) + Cu²⁺(aq) → Mg²⁺(aq) + Cu(s); taar mein electrons Mg se Cu ki taraf

blocks.prompt:
18 Describe the applications of standard electrode potential (E°) values: direction of electron flow, feasibility of a reaction, and relative strength of oxidizing and reducing agents. Give one example of each. (4 marks)
(Standard electrode potential (E°) qeematon ke istemal bayan karein: electrons ke bahao ki simt, reaction ka mumkin hona, aur oxidizing aur reducing agents ki nisbati taqat. Har aik ki aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Electrons ke bahao ki simt: dono half-cells ki E° qeematon ka muqabla batata hai ke kaun si metal electrons khoti hai. Ag⁺/Ag (+0.80 V) aur Zn²⁺/Zn (−0.76 V) ke cell mein Zn²⁺ mushkil se reduce hota hai, is liye Zn electrons khota hai; yeh bahar wali taar mein Zn half-cell (negative pole) se Ag half-cell (positive pole) ki taraf jate hain, kyunke zyada positive pole electrons ko kheenchta hai.

2. Reaction ka mumkin hona: mujawwaza reaction ke liye E°cell = E°red − E°ox; positive ka matlab mumkin, negative ka matlab mumkin nahi. Zn(s) + Cu²⁺(aq) → Zn²⁺(aq) + Cu(s): E°cell = +0.34 − (−0.76) = +1.10 V, mumkin. Ulta (Cu aur Zn²⁺) −1.10 V deta hai aur mumkin nahi; 1.00 mol dm⁻³ Zn²⁺ mein copper rakhne se koi reaction nahi hota. Taqatwar oxidizing agent taqatwar reducing agent se react karta hai.

3. Oxidizing aur reducing agents: E° zyada negative hone par baayen wali species (oxidized shakal) kamzor oxidizing agents aur daayen wali (reduced shakal) taqatwar reducing agents banti hain. Cu Zn²⁺ ko reduce nahi kar sakta; zyada negative E° wala reducing agent chahiye, jaise Mg (Mg²⁺/Mg = −2.37 V), is liye Mg Zn²⁺ ko reduce karta hai. Compounds: acidified KMnO₄ (+1.51 V) aur K₂Cr₂O₇ (+1.33 V) oxidizing agents hain (zyada E°); KI aur FeSO₄ reducing agents (kam E°); H₂O₂ dono ka kaam kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Note the following as the values of E° for each of these reduction reactions gets more negative.

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
23 What is the activity series of metals? Explain how the position of a metal in the series is related to its standard reduction potential, ease of oxidation and reactions with water and acids. (4 marks)
(Metals ki activity series kya hai? Wazahat karein ke series mein metal ki jagah us ke standard reduction potential, oxidation ki asani aur pani aur acids se reactions se kaise mutalliq hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Taareef: activity series metals ki reactivity, khaas taur par electrons khone aur oxidize hone ke rujhan, ke mutabiq darja bandi hai; yeh dar asal reactivity series hai (Table 10.2).

Series ke upar: metals ke standard reduction potentials zyada negative hain (maslan Li −3.05 V, K −2.93 V, Na −2.71 V). Yeh asani se electrons khoti hain, jaldi oxidize hoti hain aur reducing agents hain. Pani, oxygen aur acid se sab se zyada react karti hain; caesium aur sodium jaisi alkali metals pani se zor se react kar ke hydrogen nikalti hain: 2M(s) + 2H₂O(l) → 2MOH(aq) + H₂(g).

Darmiyan: Mg (−2.37 V) jaisi metals steam se react karti hain magar thande pani se nahi; Co se Pb tak ki metals pani se react nahi karti magar acids se hydrogen nikalti hain, maslan M(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MCl₂(aq) + H₂(g).

Series ke neeche: hydrogen se neeche wali metals (Cu +0.34 V, Ag +0.80 V, Au +1.50 V) ke reduction potentials zyada positive hain, asani se electrons nahi khoti, pani ya acids se react nahi karti, aur in ke ions electrons lene ka rujhan rakhte hain, yaani oxidizing agents. Gold aur silver jaisi noble metals asani se oxidize nahi hoti.

Is tarah metal ki jagah seedha us ki oxidation ki asani se mutalliq hai: potential jitna negative, metal utni reactive; series mein neeche jate hue oxidation ki asani aur reducing taqat kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, the activity series can be understood in terms of standard reduction potentials

24 What is a photovoltaic cell? Explain its principle and give its merits as a sustainable source of energy. (4 marks)
(Photovoltaic cell kya hai? Is ka usool samjhayein aur sustainable (paaedaar) energy ke zariye ke taur par is ke fawaid bataein.)
blocks.explanation:
Taareef: lafz 'photovoltaic' photo (roshni) aur volt (bijli ka potential) se bana hai. Photovoltaic (PV) cell woh cell hai jo roshni ki energy ko bijli ki energy mein badalta hai.

Usool (photovoltaic effect): roshni parne par kisi material mein voltage aur current paida hota hai. Photons ki energy semiconductor mein electrons ko valence band se conduction band mein utha deti hai. PN junction electrons aur holes ko alag karta hai aur voltage paida karta hai jo current chalata hai.

Sustainable energy ke fawaid:
1. Jab tak roshni ho photovoltaic effect jaari rehta hai, is liye yeh bijli banane ka paaedaar tareeqa hai.
2. PV system renewable (dobara milne wala) zariya hai jo dhoop ko bijli mein badalta hai.
3. PV systems suraj ki energy istemal karte hain aur fossil fuels par munhasir nahi.

book_ref.quote: The photovoltaic effect involves the excitation of electrons from the valence band to the conduction band

blocks.prompt:
25 Define biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and dissolved oxygen (DO). Explain the relationship between them and describe the principle of the Winkler method. (4 marks)
(Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) aur dissolved oxygen (DO) ki taareef karein. In ka aapas mein taaluq samjhayein aur Winkler method ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
BOD: qudrati pani mein organic maadde ki paanch din mein oxygen kharch karne ki salahiyat. Yeh dissolved organic maadde ki biological oxidation mein kharch hone wali oxygen ki miqdaar hai, jise pani mein pehle se maujood microorganisms catalyze karte hain. Isay Winkler method se paanch din ke shuru aur aakhir ki oxygen concentration se naapa jata hai; band sample andhere mein constant temperature par rakha jata hai.

DO: pani mein ghuli oxygen ki miqdaar, jo hawa se ya paudon ki photosynthesis se aati hai. Is ki concentration 5 se 8 mg/dm³ hai; kam az kam 5 mg/dm³ honi chahiye, is se kam ho to pani aaloodah samjha jata hai.

Taaluq: DO aur BOD ka ulta taaluq hai (Figure 10.12). Bacteria organic maadda decompose karte hue oxygen kharch karte hain, BOD barhti hai aur DO girti hai.

Winkler method: pani ke samples mein DO naapne ka tareeqa. Dissolved oxygen oxidizing khasiyat rakhti hai aur KI se react kar ke iodine banati hai. Banne wali iodine ko starch indicator ke saath sodium thiosulfate se titrate kiya jata hai; endpoint par solution gehra neela ho jata hai. Banne wali iodine ki miqdaar dissolved oxygen ke mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: It is based on the idea that dissolved oxygen (DO) in the sample solution, has oxidizing properties
